title: Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer
alloyReason: Pt-coated Grade 1 CP-Ti (UNS R50250) is engineered for this hydrogen hardware electrochemical application where Pt cladding (2.5um min) provides catalytic activity while the Grade 1 substrate delivers max ductility (24% elong). This rationale is driven by pem electrolyzer liquid-gas diffusion layer (sintered) and specific design requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding all positions with 0.5mm corner radius
DPI dye penetrant inspect with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction
commonFailures: Thermal ratcheting under cyclic temperature - controlled by stress-relief anneal 675C 2h Ar below beta-transus

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer suitable for PEM electrolyzer liquid-gas diffusion layer (sintered)?
faq.a: Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer uses Grade 1 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address hydrogen hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. hydrogen hardware components receive Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium PEM Gas Diffusion Layer shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for LGDL / Diffusion layer hydrogen hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
